rules.sql: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='dbsystemuat' AND (table_name LIKE '%cash%balance%cfs' OR table_name IN ( 'cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs','deal_ticket_table_cfs','security_info_table_cfs','cloned_security_info_table_cfs', 'premium_fy_table_cfs','rms_premium_paid_table_cfs','deal_active_lots_table_cfs','fixing_table_cfs','netting_id_table_cfs', 'client_master_data_cfs','client_threshold_master_table_cfs','valuation_date_table','vdate_sdate_table')) ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position
SELECT table_name,view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema='dbsystemuat' AND table_name='helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs'
